scientific_integrity: The analytic proof derives the stable-ratio Stieltjes identity, verifies the explicit quantile density, identifies all exponential tilts and the common Cramer rate, and uses a contradiction over arbitrary probability levels for uniform quantile control. Numerical samples are only replay checks.
scientific_limitations: Only an o(N) transport discrepancy is established for fixed 0<alpha<1 and a fair target binomial; neither a sharp finite-n optimum nor the conjectured O(1) bound is proved. The classical stable-ratio distribution is used, not claimed as new. Bibliographic risk remains for equivalent terminology.
title: Lamperti-quantile approximation of fractional binomials in \(W_\infty\)
